name: pollard
description: Find, verify and safely delete dead Git branches.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Pollard runs git commands in the workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Pollard requires a local git repository.

pollard.protectedBranches.description: Glob patterns for branch names Pollard will never offer to delete, regardless of merge/PR status. "*" matches any characters, including "/", so "release/*" also matches "release/2.0/hotfix". By default your patterns are merged with Pollard's built-in defaults (main, master, develop, dev, staging, release/*, hotfix/*) — set pollard.protectedBranches.replaceDefaults to true to use only your patterns instead.

pollard.protectedBranches.replaceDefault.description: When true, pollard.protectedBranches replaces Pollard's built-in default protected-branch patterns instead of being merged with them. Has no effect if pollard.protectedBranches was never set, since the merged and replaced lists are then identical.

pollard.minimumScoreForBulkDelete.description: Minimum safety score a branch needs to be pre-checked by default in the Pollard: Clean selection list. Branches below this score are still listed and can be selected manually. Defaults to 95 — the SAFE_SQUASH_MERGED score — so only fully- or squash-merged branches are pre-selected out of the box.

pollard.gitlabHost.description: Hostname only (e.g. gitlab.mycompany.com — no scheme or path) of a self-hosted GitLab instance, if not using gitlab.com. Leave empty to only recognize gitlab.com remotes.

pollard.github.enterpriseHost.description: Hostname only (e.g. github.mycompany.com — no scheme or path) of a GitHub Enterprise Server instance, if not using github.com. Leave empty to only recognize github.com remotes.

pollard.cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long cached pull request lookup results stay valid before Pollard: Scan re-fetches them from GitHub/GitLab, in minutes. Lower values keep PR status fresher at the cost of more API calls.

pollard.logLevel.description: Minimum severity of diagnostic messages Pollard would record, from least to most verbose: off, error, warn, info, debug. Diagnostics are written to the "Pollard" Output channel, which provides its own built-in level picker (the gear icon in the Output panel) — use that to control what's shown. This setting is not yet wired to that picker.

pollard.autoScanOnStartup.description: Automatically run Pollard: Scan when a workspace with a Git repository is opened. Off by default — scanning contacts GitHub/GitLab and may prompt for authentication.

pollard.autoScanIntervalMinutes.description: Automatically re-run Pollard: Scan on this interval, in minutes. 0 disables periodic scanning (default). Values below 5 are treated as 5 minutes.

pollard.backups.retentionDays.description: Backup refs (refs/pollard/backups/...) older than this are eligible for deletion by Pollard: Prune Backups. Pruning never runs automatically — only on explicit command invocation.
